title: A day at Seen Health
basis: Composite, illustrative itinerary for one participant on the shared 8 AM–4 PM care-day clock. Not a participant record; times are compressed (720 loop seconds = 480 minutes).

hero.name: Mrs. Lin
hero.summary: Lives with her daughter, attends three days a week, loves karaoke and is working on her balance after a fall last spring.
hero.note: The hero takes over the arrival-cane itinerary (Van A, escorted by arrival-aide-a) so the shared loop has no duplicate person; interactions for the replaced actor are re-derived from the steps.

steps.title: Before the doors open
steps.body: Eleven disciplines meet around one table. Who is coming today, what changed overnight, and who needs to see whom.

handoffs.note: Daughter reported a dizzy spell on Sunday
Add a blood-pressure recheck to today's visit

steps.title: Door to door
steps.body: The driver deploys the ramp and walks Mrs. Lin to the entrance. He noticed she was slower on the steps this morning, and passes it on.

handoffs.note: Slower on the steps this morning

steps.title: Known by name
steps.body: Check-in takes a minute. Her plan for the day is already waiting: clinic first, then therapy, lunch, and karaoke after.

handoffs.note: Mrs. Lin is in; clinic first

steps.title: Care, down the hall
steps.body: The nurse rechecks her blood pressure. Her doctor adjusts a medication on the spot. No separate trip, no waiting room across town.

handoffs.note: Clear for balance work; seated rests

steps.title: Stronger every week
steps.body: Parallel bars and step training with her physical therapist, then practice getting safely in and out of a shower with her occupational therapist.

handoffs.note: Balance improving; still needs a grab bar
Order a shower chair for home

steps.title: Everyday movement
steps.body: Chair exercise with friends in the day room. Standing, seated or in a wheelchair, everyone takes part.

steps.title: A meal made for her
steps.body: Low sodium and soft textures, planned by the dietitian and served warm. An attendant sits nearby, just in case.

steps.title: Someone to talk to
steps.body: A quiet conversation about her daughter's trip next week, and who will be home when the van drops her off.

handoffs.note: Arrange an evening check while daughter travels

steps.title: The best part of the day
steps.body: A gentle rally at the ping-pong table, then the karaoke room, where Mrs. Lin always sings first.

steps.title: Dignity, privately
steps.body: A supported shower and hair care, with the grab bars and shower chair her OT recommended for home.

steps.title: The plan goes home with her
steps.body: Her home care coordinator confirms tonight's check-in visit and the shower chair delivery before she heads out.

handoffs.note: Drop-off to the side door; neighbor meets her

steps.title: Safely home
steps.body: The same driver, the same ramp, a known face at the other end.

steps.title: One plan, eleven perspectives
steps.kicker: 3:00 PM · The team closes the loop
steps.body: Every observation from today lands in one shared care plan: a medication change, a shower chair, an evening visit. Tomorrow starts where today left off.

handoffs.note: Recheck blood pressure in two days
Evening visits scheduled for the week
